strokes.text: Manages one additional placement of an existing source in a scene or group: its visibility, stacking position and transform.
A source resource already owns its first placement, the anchor, so use this resource only for the second and later places the same source appears.
Both placements show the same source, and a change to the source settings is seen in every scene that places it.
Placing a Source in a Group
Set `parent_kind` to `group` and pass the name and UUID of the group in `scene_name` and `scene_uuid`.
The group must already exist and must have exactly one placement in a scene.
Never declare an `obs_scene_item` for the anchor of a source, because two resources would then own one placement.
Import a placement by collection name, container UUID, source UUID and scene item ID, separated by pipe characters:
Append `|group` when the container is a group.

glazes.index: Zero-based position in the scene or group, counted from the bottom layer up. A placement created before its lower siblings exist is placed last and moves once they do.
glazes.item_id: Scene item ID that OBS assigned to this placement. Reference it from `item_ids` of @resources/scene_contents.
glazes.scene_name: Name of the scene, or of the group when `parent_kind` is `group`, that receives the placement. It follows a rename.
glazes.scene_uuid: UUID of the scene or group that receives the placement. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.source_name: Name of the source to place. It follows a rename of the source.
glazes.source_uuid: UUID of the source to place, for example `input_uuid` of @resources/source. Changing it replaces the resource.
